questions.question: In a sad prayer from the people of Judah, what do they first ask the LORD to do?

answers.text: Remember what has happened to them
Punish Edom for all its sins
Send them a new king to lead

questions.question: To get enough bread, which two nations did the people of Judah say they submitted to in their prayer?
In their prayer, the people of Judah said they had sinned too, not only their fathers. True or false?
In their sad prayer, what did the people of Judah say about the LORD and His throne?

answers.text: He rules forever and His throne lasts
He left His throne when the city fell
His throne now sits in a far country
